info.name: JFrog Mission Control REST API
info.description:
API for centralized management and monitoring of multiple JFrog Platform instances, including Artifactory servers, configurations, and cross-instance operations. Mission Control provides a single pane of glass for managing geographically distributed JFrog deployments.

Contact Support:
 Name: JFrog
